import { onStart, type FrameCtx } from '../loop.ts';
import { defineKind, spawn } from '../entity/entity.ts';
import { me, cam } from '../player/player.ts';
import { onEntered } from '../entities/player/state.ts';
import { interactTarget } from '../player/hands.ts';
import type { Body } from '../physics/engine.ts';

defineKind('prefab-fixture-hud', { update: 39 });
onStart(() => {
  const output = document.createElement('output');
  document.body.append(output);
  onEntered(() => {
    output.dataset.entered = 'true';
  });
  spawn({
    kind: 'prefab-fixture-hud',
    update({ now }: FrameCtx) {
      const body: Body | null = me.body;
      output.textContent = `${me.name}: ${body?.position.y ?? 0}, ${cam.yaw}, ${now}, ${interactTarget()?.verb ?? ''}`;
    },
    dispose() {
      output.remove();
    },
  });
});
